name: Riviera Summer
about: Half-year pass that opens around the end of September. It starts one season length after season 2 (see starts in season_1.json). Summer luxury on the coast: linen, yachts, marinas, casino nights and neon sunsets. Outfits, backdrops, flairs, boxes, small gold and XP boosts in every rarity, tiers 1 to 50. kind and art slots as in season_2.json. Image: <kind>.<id>.png in App/Ledger/Resources/Content/art; legendary rewards also have a short loop <slot>.anim.mp4.
